🔥 Lock in a .store domain for your store before it's too late: https://go.store/isaacverse (use code ISAACVERSE at checkout for a special deal!)

Most youtube scripting tutorials give you a "secret 5-step framework" that just creates "optimized" videos. But what if there's a better way to write video scripts?

In this video, I'm breaking down how I write viral youtube scripts, from planning to the final script.

If you want to learn how to write better youtube scripts, how to use storytelling, or how to build an audience that actually cares about your content, I'm sure you're gonna get something from this one. Hope you enjoy 🙂
